$comment: Allowed-diffs for the .d.ts export parity gate (tests/dts-parity.cjs). DECLARATION-ONLY: this gate and file concern ONLY the emitted dist/*.d.ts declaration content. They assert nothing about package.json main/exports, index.js, the native loader, or *.node — those belong to the deferred TS-only Node package migration. Each allowedDiffs entry permits exactly one emitted file content (by sha256) to differ from the committed baseline, with a rationale; it cannot blanket-permit a file. When the public type surface intentionally changes, regenerate the baseline with `npm run dts:baseline` (preferred) or add an entry here.

rationales.rationale: Plan 11 Phase 1: additive instance/static serialization API to/from the canonical plain dict, mirroring Python to_dict()/from_dict().
Plan 11 Phase 1: schema-derived plain-dict shape produced by toDict() and consumed by fromDict() — no `any` escape hatch.
Plan 11 Phase 1: serialization-only unwrap / re-brand helpers reused by toDict()/fromDict().
